title: Limitations
vignette: >
  %\VignetteIndexEntry{Limitations}
  %\VignetteEngine{quarto::html}
  %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8}
---

We attempt to keep fastreg a rather small and simple package. However,
this comes with some limitations as listed below.

1. `convert_file()`, the core function behind converting SAS files to
   Parquet and used within `convert_register()` and the targets
   template, creates an Arrow schema with data types based on the first
   file chunk. This means that data type schemas are defined *within*
   files only. As a result, if there's a drift in data types across SAS
   files in the same register, this may not be identified in the
   conversion process, but will become evident when attempting to read
   the register.
